claim_boundary: Static owner schema and fixture evidence only. Every record binds a declared request to the owner-selected rule projection and an observed result through scripts/pm_permissions_rule_command_contracts.py. An owner original is never proven by a field of the same binding: the declared current file hash and the declared pre-state rule projection are declarations that an independent owner read must confirm, and a binding without that independent read is reported explicitly unproven. The static gate's separate pinned owner-original double (scripts/pm_permissions_rule_command_owner_file_double.py) is static test evidence and never a native producer. No native handler, production wiring, filesystem write, permission decision, receipt, admitted EventRecord, storage family or key, migration, or readiness claim is made; a receipt/no-event disposition is not an admitted EventRecord.

coverage.owner_original_witness: scripts/pm_permissions_rule_command_owner_file_double.py supplies the separate pinned owner-file generations and the pinned owner-selected rule originals for the static scenarios as static test evidence only; it is never a native producer, and a scenario it does not pin is reported unproven.
coverage.owner_file_hash_syntax: File hashes are opaque owner-computed tokens (no digest, encoding or serialization is chosen by the cited owner text): generation-1 is the scenario's current load, generation-2 a post-write read-back and the superseded token a generation the owner no longer has.
coverage.removed_unowned_caps: The owner names no 64-rule cap, no 4096 order index, no string-length cap, no glob grammar and no timestamp or parse-position format; those restrictions were removed rather than re-pinned, and positives above the removed rule/index caps are declared here.

negative_cases.name: causal.stale_request_hash_then_fabricated_success
negative_cases.without_join: A join that derives the outcome from scope and rule identity but never checks the declared loaded_config_hash currency accepts the fabricated write.

negative_cases.name: causal.fabricated_success_without_applying_draft
negative_cases.without_join: A join that verifies only the declared config hash accepts a result whose rule set never applied the request draft.

negative_cases.name: causal.success_binds_other_rule_identity
negative_cases.without_join: A join that accepts any rule identity already present in the owner snapshot accepts this internally consistent but wrong identity.

negative_cases.name: causal.blocked_payload_without_recovery_actions
negative_cases.without_join: A join that only checks that the blocked family and reason code are closed-enum values accepts a blocked payload with no canonical allowed_action_ids[].

negative_cases.name: causal.create_binds_preexisting_rule_identity
negative_cases.without_join: A join that accepts any well-formed rule identity, or that never compares the created identity against the pre-write owner projection, accepts a create that reuses an existing durable rule id.

negative_cases.name: causal.cross_scope_reorder_fabricated_success
negative_cases.without_join: A join that trusts the observed success and only checks the result's own shape accepts a rule moved across scopes.

negative_cases.name: causal.not_writable_config_fabricated_success
negative_cases.without_join: A join that never consults the owner's writable state accepts a persisted write into a config the owner reports as not writable.

negative_cases.name: causal.mutation_without_required_command_field
negative_cases.without_join: A join that validates each record only against its own closed shape accepts an update request that never carried the draft it claims to have applied.

negative_cases.name: causal.approval_created_outside_create
negative_cases.without_join: A join that treats approval_created as a plain boolean accepts an update that claims to have minted a durable approval.

negative_cases.name: causal.validation_changed_rule_scope
negative_cases.without_join: A join that accepts any rule list on a validation accepts a draft validation that reports a changed rule set.

negative_cases.name: causal.no_write_outcome_claims_receipt
negative_cases.without_join: A join that only matches the refusal error code accepts a refused write that claims a persistence receipt.

negative_cases.name: causal.write_conflict_reports_save_failed
negative_cases.without_join: A join that never relates the owner's write conflict to the save dirty-state machine accepts a conflict that reports plain save_failed instead of conflict_refresh_required.

negative_cases.name: causal.denied_permission_fabricated_success
negative_cases.without_join: A join that reads the permission evidence record only for internal ladder consistency accepts a persisted write under an effective deny.

negative_cases.name: causal.validation_claims_persistence_receipt
negative_cases.without_join: A join that only checks the validation disposition kind accepts a validation that claims a persistence receipt.

negative_cases.name: causal.validation_creates_approval
negative_cases.without_join: A join that does not compare validation success against the no-approval rule accepts an approval minted by a draft validation.

negative_cases.name: causal.permission_evidence_widened
negative_cases.without_join: A join that only checks that both permission states are closed-enum values accepts an effective state that widens the requested state.

negative_cases.name: causal.refusal_error_code_swapped
negative_cases.without_join: A join that only checks the observed code belongs to the closed owner error set accepts the wrong code for the derived conflict.

negative_cases.name: causal.result_command_identity_swapped
negative_cases.without_join: A join that validates each record against its own definition without cross-record identity agreement accepts two different commands in one binding.

negative_cases.name: causal.dispatch_receipt_from_other_command
negative_cases.without_join: A join that treats any well-formed dispatch receipt as binding evidence accepts a receipt minted for another command; a receipt is not an admitted EventRecord.

negative_cases.name: causal.state_selector_from_other_command
negative_cases.without_join: A join that only checks the selector string shape accepts an availability projection wired to the wrong command id.

negative_cases.name: causal.unavailable_command_persisted_write
negative_cases.without_join: A join that reads the availability record and the result independently accepts an owner write that the unavailable handler projection forbids.

negative_cases.name: causal.unknown_effect_claims_post_state
negative_cases.without_join: A join that never distinguishes an unknown effect from a settled one accepts a reconciliation-free claim about the post-write file state.

negative_cases.name: causal.persisted_write_reports_dirty
negative_cases.without_join: A join that ignores the save dirty-state machine accepts a persisted write that still reports unsaved changes.

negative_cases.name: causal.atomic_steps_missing_fsync
negative_cases.without_join: A join that only checks that the result claims an atomic write accepts a step sequence that skips fsync-temp.

negative_cases.name: causal.global_scope_against_project_layer
negative_cases.without_join: A join that trusts the observed scope_mismatch refusal accepts a request scope the selected file and layer cannot own.

negative_cases.name: causal.delete_loses_removed_rule_identity
negative_cases.without_join: A join that checks only the deletion hash accepts a deletion whose retained record is not the removed rule identity.

negative_cases.name: causal.reorder_reports_wrong_order_index
negative_cases.without_join: A join that verifies the config hash but never the derived post-order accepts a reorder whose reported position contradicts the derived order.

negative_cases.name: causal.truthful_derivation_observes_refusal
negative_cases.without_join: A join that accepts any internally consistent refusal without comparing it to the derived outcome accepts a refusal where the owner semantics require a completed update.

negative_cases.name: causal.owner_file_hash_comutated_stale_true_anchor
negative_cases.without_join: a join that trusts the binding's own declared request and snapshot hashes accepts a write against a superseded file generation; the independent owner current-file read rejects it

negative_cases.name: causal.owner_selected_original_comutated_created_at
negative_cases.without_join: a join that derives the result from the binding's own embedded pre-state and compares it with the binding's own post-state accepts a co-mutated rule metadata pair; the independent owner-selected original keeps the real created_at and rejects it

negative_cases.name: causal.owner_selected_original_comutated_delete_value
negative_cases.without_join: a join that only checks the retained deleted-rule identity against the binding's own snapshot accepts a co-mutated removed rule value; the independent owner-selected original still carries the durable value and rejects it

negative_cases.name: causal.owner_selected_original_unpinned_scenario
negative_cases.without_join: a gate that has no independent owner-selected original for a scenario must report the binding unproven; accepting it would let the binding's own embedded snapshot act as its own authority

negative_cases.name: causal.post_write_hash_not_owner_readback
negative_cases.without_join: a join that accepts the declared observed hash of a persisted write without an independent owner post-write read-back credits a write whose file state nobody observed
